welcomeTitle.en: Let's get you ready for your visit.
welcomeTitle.translation: Hebu tuwe tayari kwa ajili ya ziara yako.

welcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about your symptoms. Your doctor reviews everything before you meet.
welcomeSubtitle.translation: Jibu maswali machache kuhusu dalili zako.

identitySubtitle.en: This connects your visit to your record.
identitySubtitle.translation: Hilo linahusianisha ziara yako na rekodi yako.

interviewComplete.en: Thanks, {name}. I have what I need. Let's review your answers before sending them to the doctor.
interviewComplete.translation: Asante, {name}. Nina kile ninachohitaji. Hebu tuangalie majibu yako kabla ya kuyatuma kwa daktari.

interviewOpener.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about your {complaint}. When did it start?
interviewOpener.translation: Asante Nitakuuliza maswali machache ya haraka kuhusu {complaint} yako.

interviewOpenerFallback.en: Thanks — I'll ask a few quick questions about what brought you in. When did it start?
interviewOpenerFallback.translation: Asante Nitakuuliza maswali machache ya haraka kuhusu nini kilichokuleta ndani.

composerHintChips.en: Type a reply, or tap a suggestion above
composerHintChips.translation: Andika jibu, au bonyeza pendekezo hapo juu

reviewSubtitle.en: Tap any item to fix it before sending.
reviewSubtitle.translation: Bonyeza kitu chochote ili kukirekebisha kabla ya kutuma.

emergencyNotice.en: If your symptoms feel severe or are getting worse right now, don't wait — call emergency services.
emergencyNotice.translation: Ikiwa dalili zako zinaonekana kuwa kali au zinazidi kuwa mbaya sasa, usisubiri piga simu huduma za dharura.

urgencySeekCare.translation: Tafadhali pata huduma ndani ya saa 12

urgencyBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that should be seen soon. We've flagged your case as urgent for the clinical team.
urgencyBody.translation: Dalili zako zinaonyesha kitu ambacho kinapaswa kuonekana hivi karibuni. Tumeweka alama kesi yako kama ya dharura kwa timu ya kliniki.

urgencyStep1Desc.en: The clinical team receives your structured history immediately.
urgencyStep1Desc.translation: Timu ya kliniki inapokea historia yako iliyojengwa mara moja.

urgencyStep2Desc.en: Based on {level} urgency. You will be notified when a clinician opens it.
urgencyStep2Desc.translation: Kulingana na {level} dharura, utaarifiwa wakati daktari kufungua.

urgencyStep3Title.translation: Ikizidi kuwa mbaya, chukua hatua haraka

urgencyStep3Desc.en: Severe or sudden worsening — call emergency services right away.
urgencyStep3Desc.translation: Mgogoro mkubwa au wa papo hapo piga simu huduma za dharura mara moja.

notADiagnosis.en: This is an automated urgency estimate, not a diagnosis. A clinician makes the final decision.
notADiagnosis.translation: Huu ni makadirio ya haraka ya kiotomatiki, si utambuzi.

findHeroSubtitle.en: You've been seen at this hospital before. Send your brief straight there?
findHeroSubtitle.translation: Umewahi kuonekana katika hospitali hii kabla.

findHeroRecordsNote.en: They already hold your records, so your care team sees your full history right away.
findHeroRecordsNote.translation: Tayari wana rekodi zako, kwa hiyo timu yako ya utunzaji itaona historia yako kamili mara moja.

findSearchTitle.en: Where would you like to be seen?

findSearchSubtitle.en: Pick a Triavi hospital near you — your {level} brief is sent the moment you choose.
findSearchSubtitle.translation: Chagua hospitali ya Triavi karibu na wewe taarifa yako ya {level} itatumwa wakati wewe kuchagua.

findScanning.translation: Kuchunguza hospitali za Triavi karibu na wewe...

findErrLocation.en: We couldn't get your location. Tap rescan to try again.

statusBody.en: Your brief is with the care team. We'll notify you the moment a clinician opens it.
statusBody.translation: Taarifa yako iko na timu ya huduma, tutakujulisha mara tu daktari atakapoifungua.

escalateTitle.en: If it's getting worse, act now
escalateTitle.translation: Kama ni mbaya zaidi, kutenda sasa

escalateBody.en: Don't wait for your queue position. If your symptoms are severe or worsening suddenly — call emergency services now or go to the nearest emergency department.
escalateBody.translation: Ikiwa dalili zako ni kali au zinazidi kuwa mbaya ghafla, piga simu huduma za dharura sasa au tembelea idara ya dharura ya karibu.

escalateCallEmergency.translation: Piga simu kwa huduma za dharura

escalateFlagged.en: We've flagged your case as higher priority so the care team is aware.
escalateFlagged.translation: Tumeweka alama kesi yako kama kipaumbele cha juu ili timu ya huduma iweze kujua.

notifyBody.en: A clinician is reviewing your brief. We'll update you as it progresses.
notifyBody.translation: Daktari anachunguza ripoti yako, tutakujulisha kadiri inavyoendelea.

checkinWelcomeSubtitle.en: Answer a few questions about how you've been since your visit.
checkinWelcomeSubtitle.translation: Jibu maswali machache kuhusu jinsi umekuwa tangu ziara yako.

checkinTrendAriaLabel.en: How is your condition compared to before?
checkinTrendAriaLabel.translation: Hali yako inalinganishwaje na ya awali?

checkinAnythingElse.en: Anything else you'd like to tell us?

checkinResultReview.en: A clinician will look at this today

checkinResultReviewBody.en: Your answers have been sent to the care team. A clinician will review them and reach out if needed.
checkinResultReviewBody.translation: Majibu yako yametumwa kwa timu ya huduma, na daktari atayachunguza na kuwasiliana nayo ikiwa ni lazima.

checkinResultEscalateBody.en: Your symptoms suggest something that needs prompt attention. Don't wait — contact your care team or go to the nearest emergency department.
checkinResultEscalateBody.translation: Dalili zako zinaonyesha kwamba unahitaji kushughulikiwa haraka. Usisubiri wasiliana na timu yako ya huduma au nenda kwenye idara ya dharura iliyo karibu zaidi.

checkinResultEscalateCall.translation: Piga simu kwa huduma za dharura

checkinExpiredBody.en: This follow-up is no longer available. Sign in to see your current check-ins.
checkinExpiredBody.translation: Ufuatiliaji huu haupatikani tena. Ingia ili uone kuingia kwako kwa sasa.

claimBody.en: Your check-in is verified. Create a free account to track this visit and skip the code next time.
claimBody.translation: Kuingia kwako ni kuthibitishwa. Unda akaunti ya bure kufuatilia ziara hii na kuruka kificho wakati ujao.

authVerifyBody.en: We'll send a one-time code — no password to remember.
authVerifyBody.translation: Tutatuma nambari ya mara moja hakuna password ya kukumbuka.

otpSentTo.en: Sent to {dest}. It expires in 10 minutes.
otpSentTo.translation: Imepelekwa kwa {dest}. Inaisha baada ya dakika 10.

signinBody.en: Enter your phone or email and we'll send a sign-in code.
signinBody.translation: Ingiza simu yako au barua pepe na tutatuma nambari ya kuingia.

signinAccountTied.en: Your account is tied to your hospital's records
signinAccountTied.translation: Akaunti yako imeunganishwa na rekodi za hospitali yako

errInvalidPhone.en: Enter a valid phone number (7–14 digits)
errInvalidPhone.translation: Ingiza namba ya simu halali (714 digiti)

errSendFailed.en: Couldn't send the code. Try again.

errNetwork.en: Network error. Check your connection and try again.
errNetwork.translation: Kosa la mtandao. Angalia uhusiano wako na jaribu tena.

errCodeMismatch.en: That code didn't match. Try again.

sessionExpiredBody.en: For your security and to protect patient data, you've been signed out after a period of inactivity.
sessionExpiredBody.translation: Kwa ajili ya usalama wako na kulinda data ya wagonjwa, umejiondoa baada ya kipindi cha ukosefu wa utendaji.

dashNoActiveHint.en: Start a check-in to begin a new visit.
dashNoActiveHint.translation: Anza kuingia ili kuanza ziara mpya.

dashCareLinePrivacy.en: Care calls ring in this app · your phone number is never shared.
dashCareLinePrivacy.translation: Piga simu za huduma kwenye programu hii · nambari yako ya simu haishirikiwi kamwe.

dashRecentCalls.translation: Mawasiliano ya hivi karibuni ya huduma

voiceSubtitle.en: Choose who calls you, and how they sound.
voiceSubtitle.translation: Chagua ni nani anayekuita, na jinsi wanavyosikia.

toneWarmDesc.translation: Ni jambo lenye kuburudisha na lisilo na haraka

toneProfessionalDesc.translation: Moja kwa moja, kwa usahihi, bila mazungumzo

toneUpbeatDesc.translation: Nguvu ya kirafiki na yenye kutia moyo

voiceSampleQuote.en: Hi Jordan, it's time for your evening dose…
voiceSampleQuote.translation: Hi Jordan, ni wakati wa dozi yako ya jioni...

medReminderCallsDesc.translation: Funga wakati wa kila kipimo kilichopangwa

postVisitCalls.translation: Piga simu za kufuatilia baada ya ziara

quietHoursDesc.en: No calls 9:30 PM – 7:30 AM · falls back to a notification
quietHoursDesc.translation: Hakuna wito 9:30 PM 7:30 AM · huanguka nyuma kwa taarifa

signedOutBody.en: Your care line stays active — sign back in to manage calls and reminders.
signedOutBody.translation: Mstari wako wa huduma unabaki hai ingia tena kusimamia simu na vikumbusho.

callRingVerified.translation: Imethibitishwa · kupitia mstari wako wa huduma {code}

callRingWebRtcFootnote.en: Encrypted voice call · WebRTC · your number is never shared
callRingWebRtcFootnote.translation: Wito wa sauti uliofichwa · WebRTC · nambari yako haishirikiwi kamwe

callSummaryReported.translation: Ujumbe kwa Timu Yako ya Kutunza

visitsPrivacyNote.en: Only you and {hospital} can see these. Tap a visit to read the summary shared with you.
visitsPrivacyNote.translation: Ni wewe tu na {hospital} unaweza kuona haya. Bonyeza ziara kusoma muhtasari kushiriki na wewe.

visitDetailCalls.translation: ZAWADI ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA ZA Z

visitDetailNoCalls.en: No care calls for this visit yet.
visitDetailNoCalls.translation: Hakuna haja ya tahadhari kwa ajili ya ziara hii bado.

visitDetailNotDiagnosis.en: This is a summary shared with you — not a diagnosis. If your symptoms return or get worse, seek emergency care right away.
visitDetailNotDiagnosis.translation: Hii ni muhtasari ulioshirikiwa na wewe si utambuzi. Ikiwa dalili zako zinarudi au zinazidi kuwa mbaya, tafuta huduma ya dharura mara moja.

visitDetailNotFoundBody.en: This visit may have been removed, or the link is no longer valid. Go back to see your full history.
visitDetailNotFoundBody.translation: Huenda ziara hiyo iliondolewa, au kiungo hicho hakifai tena.

visitDetailDischargeBadge.translation: Aliachiliwa na timu yako ya huduma

editProfileSubtitle.en: Update your details. Your doctor sees the latest.
editProfileSubtitle.translation: Weka maelezo yako ya karibuni, daktari wako ataona habari za karibuni zaidi.

placeholderEmergencyName.translation: Jina la mawasiliano yako ya dharura

placeholderEmergencyRelation.translation: Kwa mfano, Mume au Mke, Mzazi

profilePreferredLanguageDesc.en: Changes the language of every screen instantly.
profilePreferredLanguageDesc.translation: Kubadilisha lugha ya kila skrini papo hapo.

profileCareLineCopyFailed.en: Couldn't copy - select and copy manually
profileCareLineCopyFailed.translation: Haikuweza kunakili - kuchagua na kunakili kwa mkono

privacySubtitle.en: What we protect, and what you control.

privacyDeidBody.en: Your name, contact details, and free-text answers are stripped before anything leaves your hospital. Only your care team sees identifying details; research and analytics see de-identified data only.
privacyDeidBody.translation: Jina lako, maelezo ya mawasiliano, na majibu ya maandishi ya bure huondolewa kabla ya kitu chochote kuondoka hospitali yako.

privacyResearchConsentDesc.en: Allow de-identified data to improve care for everyone. You can change this anytime.
privacyResearchConsentDesc.translation: Ruhusu data zisizojulikana kuboresha huduma kwa kila mtu. Unaweza kubadilisha hii wakati wowote.

privacyCommsConsentDesc.en: Appointment reminders and follow-up check-ins by call or push. You can change this anytime.
privacyCommsConsentDesc.translation: Kumbukumbu ya muda na kufuatilia check-in kwa simu au kushinikiza. Unaweza kubadilisha hii wakati wowote.

privacyDeleteDesc.en: Permanently remove your account and contact details. Your care-line history is retained by your hospital as required by law.
privacyDeleteDesc.translation: Kuondoa akaunti yako na maelezo ya mawasiliano daima. Historia yako ya mstari wa huduma huhifadhiwa na hospitali yako kama inavyotakiwa na sheria.

privacyDownloadDesc.en: Request a copy of your visit summaries, medications, and care-call history.
privacyDownloadDesc.translation: Omba nakala ya muhtasari wa ziara zako, dawa, na historia ya kutembelewa.

deleteSheetBody.en: This permanently removes your account and contact details. Your hospital retains your care-line history as required by law. This cannot be undone.
deleteSheetBody.translation: Hii huondoa kabisa akaunti yako na maelezo ya mawasiliano. Hospitali yako huhifadhi historia yako ya mstari wa huduma kama inavyotakiwa na sheria. Hii haiwezi kufutwa.

deleteRequestNextStep.en: Your care team will confirm by email within 72 hours. Your care line stays active until then.
deleteRequestNextStep.translation: Timu yako ya huduma itathibitisha kwa barua pepe ndani ya masaa 72.

downloadSheetBody.en: Choose a format and request your export. We'll prepare it and send a secure link to your registered email.
downloadSheetBody.translation: Chagua umbizo na kuomba nje yako. Tutaandaa na kutuma kiungo salama kwa barua pepe yako iliyosajiliwa.

downloadRequestNextStep.en: We'll email a secure link to your registered address within 24 hours.
downloadRequestNextStep.translation: Tutatuma barua pepe kiungo salama kwa anwani yako iliyosajiliwa ndani ya masaa 24.

downloadFileStubNote.en: No file is downloaded here - your records are sent securely to your registered email.
downloadFileStubNote.translation: Hakuna faili inayopakuliwa hapa - rekodi zako zinatumwa salama kwa barua pepe yako iliyosajiliwa.

callSummaryDeclinedLogged.en: Call declined ? logged as no contact
callSummaryDeclinedLogged.translation: Wito walikataliwa? kumbukumbu kama hakuna mawasiliano

callSummaryEndedLogged.en: Call ended ? logged as no contact
callSummaryEndedLogged.translation: Simu imekamilika? imeandikwa kama hakuna mawasiliano

inviteBody.en: Paste the invite link your hospital sent, or scan their QR code.
inviteBody.translation: Weka kiunga cha mwaliko uliotumwa na hospitali yako, au chunguza nambari yao ya QR.

inviteError.en: That doesn't look like a Triavi invite link or code.
inviteError.translation: Hiyo haionekani kama Triavi mwaliko kiungo au code.

inviteScanSubtitle.en: Point your camera at the code

inviteEnterManually.translation: Ingiza kiunga cha mwaliko kwa mkono

inviteInfoStreaming.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details.
inviteInfoStreaming.translation: Nambari halali ya kliniki inakupeleka moja kwa moja kwenye maelezo yako.

inviteInfoDev.en: A valid clinic code takes you straight to your details. Dev: tap Simulate detected code to test the flow.
inviteInfoDev.translation: Nambari halali kliniki inakupeleka moja kwa moja kwa maelezo yako. Dev: bonyeza Simulate code kugundua kupima mtiririko.

inviteInfoDenied.en: Grant camera permission in your browser settings, or enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoDenied.translation: Kutoa kamera ruhusa katika mipangilio browser yako, au kuingia mwito kiungo manually.

inviteInfoNoDevice.en: No camera detected. Enter the invite link your hospital sent instead.
inviteInfoNoDevice.translation: Hakuna kamera iliyogunduliwa. Ingiza kiunga cha mwaliko ambacho hospitali yako ilituma badala yake.

inviteInfoUnavailable.en: Camera isn't available right now. Enter the invite link manually.
inviteInfoUnavailable.translation: Kamera haipatikani sasa hivi. Ingiza kiunga cha mwaliko kwa mkono.

interviewOfflineTitle.en: Offline ? showing the saved interview script
interviewOfflineTitle.translation: Offline? kuonyesha script ya mahojiano kuhifadhiwa
